content.text:
when bumping into a secret wall, instead of "needing" to do search, let people that bump into the wall three times discover the door with good messgaes.

ignite weapons does not appear to be working, or, it should have a much higher chance to apply burning; and, it should show the usual flaming weapon "thing" -- like envenomed does.

commit and bump and push when ready

I’m going to trace the existing secret-wall search/discovery and envenomed/ignite status paths, then implement both changes with focused tests, bump `VERSION`, run the relevant guardrails, and commit/push on `master`. I’m using the repo’s `agent-tools` and `using-entire` guidance to preserve the project’s architecture and checkpoint history.

content.text: The working tree is currently clean, so there are no user edits to preserve. The existing secret-door path confirms the issue: only the search resolver reveals or hints at doors, while blocked movement has no secret-door state transition. Ignite already creates a temporary effect, but melee applies burn at only 20% and does not emit the visual/status event used by the envenomed presentation. I’m tracing those exact contracts now before patching.
